# Direction: [0, 0, 1]

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
dimension 3
boundary p p s

# Read structure

# Replicate 5 times in each direction
replicate 5 5 5

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Compute settings
compute pe all pe/atom
compute ke all ke/atom

# Thermo output
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe ke etotal press vol

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 10000 100000

# Output final energy
variable final_energy equal etotal
print "Final Total Energy: ${final_energy} eV"

# Write relaxed structure
